title: Legacy 1280/5×5/25f Sprite Sheet Retirement
doctrine: CartoonCoffee-only production VFX. Legacy assets deleted from disk are retired from the runtime registry. Generic variable-grid engine support is preserved. Actions with no CartoonCoffee replacement are UNRESOLVED.

summary.runtimeBehavior: VfxSystem skips unresolved spriteSheet steps with DEV warning; non-sprite steps (screenShake, hitStop, screenFlash) still play

changes.change: Removed _legacySheetDefinitions spread from VFX_SPRITE_SHEETS. Only _nativeSheetDefinitions are included. LEGACY_SPRITE_SHEET_IDS export retained for reference. Generic engine UV math (getVfxSpriteSheetFrameUv, setVfxSpriteSheetFrame) unchanged.

Added unresolved-definition guard to playSpriteSheetBillboard, playSpriteSheetProjectile, and playSpriteSheetSkyDescent. When VFX_SPRITE_SHEETS[id] is undefined, logs DEV warning and returns early — no texture load, no sprite creation.
resolveSourceStatus now returns UNRESOLVED for steps with spriteSheetId but no resolvable definition. LEGACY status removed from production path.
resolveSheetSource already returns null for unknown sheet IDs — no change needed. Legacy IDs naturally resolve to null.

testsUpdated: src/combat/vfx/VfxSpriteSheets.test.ts — removed legacy PNG file checks; added R2C-C.1 doctrine tests
src/combat/vfx/vfxRuntimeRegistry.test.ts — replaced legacy invariant tests with retirement tests; generic engine UV tested with synthetic definitions
src/combat/vfx/VfxResourceManager.test.ts — test 26 uses native sheet; added 26b for legacy null resolution
src/combat/vfx/VfxActionRegistry.test.ts — audit row tests accept legacy IDs as not-in-registry; runtime filenames allow empty for legacy
src/combat/vfx/spritesheetPng.test.ts — replaced legacy PNG tests with megapack-runtime PNG tests
src/combat/vfx/VfxR3F.test.ts — effective scale minimums adjusted for retired legacy sheets
src/combat/combatVfxPresentation.test.ts — boss_inferno layer check handles undefined definition
preserved: _legacySheetDefinitions object (historical reference, not in runtime registry)
All pilot presets with native megapack sheet references
VfxResourceManager cache, LRU, and dedup architecture
resolveCandidateSource and resolveCandidateAvailability for DEV preview
